preconditions: Unique basal-contact projections in bottom-up order
One declared unit per basal contact
Every unit explicitly names its basal contact and its next-contact or Terrain top boundary
decisionLogic: A unit sample exists only where both its basal and top boundaries are supported; terrain is the top of the uppermost unit.
Reject contact-order violations and contacts above terrain; never clip or reorder them.
Extend the uppermost unit to terrain only when its declaration explicitly names Terrain as the top boundary.
uncertainty: Ordering tolerance is an explicit project numerical parameter and is not geological evidence resolution
validationMethod: Partial coverage, crossing, above-terrain, duplicate-contact and station-misalignment tests
reopenCondition: Fault-separated domains, erosional truncation, pinch-out or probabilistic contact order is introduced
